name: 3DtoElse
summary: ReShade shader that converts an anaglyph stereo signal into SBS, TAB, or interleaved output. Used downstream of games or pipelines that only natively output anaglyph (e.g. FEZ, Limbo, some Geo-11 configurations). Not a rendering method — converts an existing stereo signal.
compatibility_notes: Input must be a red/cyan anaglyph frame. Some game-specific variants exist (FEZ, Limbo) that handle UI elements rendered outside the anaglyph pass.
